profile: Independent bounded review of three acquisition and gas-regression changes
tier: CPU/source only; no browser/GPU tier measured
scoreMeaning: Required schema field, unscored placeholder. This is no numerical quality or element-achievement score.
blindComparison: No blind comparison was conducted. Source identity was known and no actual browser or reference-work audio/video was evaluated. Which game a stranger would prefer and every element-level judgment remain not measured.
scope: Review of AUDIO_ONLY routing and failure accounting, existing CI Chromium audio-acquisition placement, and the full-then-fresh-half choice/save regression helper only. Related production sources were read and used for bounded CPU integration. None of the target or product files was edited.

measurements.result: The actual gate source body, with browser/capture/IO imports replaced only at boundaries, rejects incomplete clips, unavailable capture, helper exceptions, failed internal checks and page errors. Success alone records passed; all negative fixtures exit 1 and preserve the report. Default mode enters the original full WebKit branch. Cleanup runs in every case.

The submitted workflow already installs Chromium and WebKit. AUDIO_ONLY is isolated to the later Chromium step and output directory. Full WebKit and fault steps retain their prior environments. The audio artifact is uploaded even on failure; capture does not continue after cancellation. No continue-on-error masks failure.

The real helper callbacks run against a complete actual City, a source-extracted production startNewGame closure, actual Director.startConversation, DialogueRunner.choose, Game.fixedUpdate, Storage.save and Director.applySave. Eighteen checks pass; old full-choice flags are cleared before half choice, source states and saved bytes/progression are checked, and missing-row fixtures are expressly identified as synthetic.

Six independent source/CPU controls found no surviving defect. Deliberate missing-reset and stale vents_shut controls fail the same source-state predicates, showing that the proposed helper does not silently accept full-choice contamination.

observedCPUValues.scope: CPU fixture only. Each requested frame advanced one 1/60-second fixed tick; these values are not WebKit measurements and are not compared as matched-time aesthetic/quality evidence.

limitations: No browser process, local server or network request was started. This review neither changes nor bypasses browser/security restrictions.

The routing probe stubs Playwright, the audio helper, filesystem writes and external boundaries. It does not prove MediaRecorder support, actual recorded tracks, codec support, byte completeness or non-silent content.

The gas integration stubs Canvas/text appearance, UI, frame scheduling and screenshot calls. It creates zero screenshots. Its report contains requested screenshot paths as callback evidence only, never actual images.
The gas integration uses native storage serialization with a Map-backed localStorage API. Browser quota, persistence failure behavior and actual page transitions remain for the authorized CI.
The separate refutation used a small artificial gas layout only for state contamination controls; it adds no actual City exposure, visibility, survival or performance measurement.

The full WebKit route was verified to remain reachable, not re-executed to completion. The authorized CI must measure the current build, half-choice browser state, and all three real audiovisual recordings.
Captured media still requires decoding and content inspection. A present track, byte count or a passed acquisition gate is not audio quality, physical-phone evidence or a valid blind comparison.
No element is promoted to satisfied by this bounded PASS.
